f.title: Definition: therapeutic failure
f.statement: Therapeutic failure is any situation in which the expected effect of the medicine used in the patient is not achieved under adequate dosing according to the prescription used for prophylactic, diagnostic or therapeutic purposes or to modify a physiological function.
f.clause: Título I, Capítulo I, Artículo 2 (definiciones), numeral 64

rows.actor: All parties reporting to the National Pharmacovigilance Centre
rows.quote: 64. Falla terapéutica. Toda aquella situación en que no se logre el efecto esperado del medicamento utilizado en el paciente, bajo dosificaciones adecuadas según la prescripción utilizada con fines profilácticos, diagnósticos, terapéuticos o para modificar una función fisiológica.
rows.location: Título I, Capítulo I, Artículo 2 (definiciones), numeral 64
rows.review_note: Review: cross-reference to Articles 323 and 325 removed from the statement (not in the quote). Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: 64. Therapeutic failure. Any situation in which the expected effect of the medicine used in the patient is not achieved, under adequate dosing according to the prescription used for prophylactic, diagnostic, therapeutic purposes or to modify a physiological function.

f.title: Definition: serious adverse reaction
f.statement: A serious adverse reaction is any adverse reaction that may endanger life, requires hospitalisation of the patient or prolongs existing hospitalisation, causes disability or significant or persistent invalidity, constitutes a congenital anomaly or birth defect, or causes death.
f.clause: Título I, Capítulo I, Artículo 2 (definiciones), numeral 136

rows.actor: All parties reporting to the National Pharmacovigilance Centre
rows.quote: 136. Reacción adversa grave o seria. Cualquier reacción adversa que pueda poner en peligro la vida, que exija la hospitalización del paciente o la prolongación de la hospitalización ya existente, ocasione una discapacidad, una invalidez significativa, persistente o constituya una anomalía congénita o defecto de nacimiento u ocasione la muerte.
rows.location: Título I, Capítulo I, Artículo 2 (definiciones), numeral 136
rows.review_note: Review: cross-reference to Articles 325-326 removed from the statement (not in the quote); the definition determines which reporting deadline applies. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: 136. Serious adverse reaction. Any adverse reaction that may endanger life, requires hospitalisation of the patient or prolongation of existing hospitalisation, causes disability, significant or persistent invalidity, or constitutes a congenital anomaly or birth defect, or causes death.

f.title: Include a pharmacovigilance plan and risk management programme in biological product registration
f.statement: To obtain a sanitary registration for a biological product, the applicant must submit, among other items, own clinical studies (or comparative studies with the innovator) demonstrating safety, efficacy and quality, a pharmacovigilance plan and a risk management programme.
f.clause: Título II, Artículo 102 (registro sanitario de productos biológicos), numerales 5-7

rows.actor: Applicant for sanitary registration of a biological product
rows.quote: 5. Estudios clínicos propios que demuestren la seguridad, eficacia y calidad del producto o estudios comparativos con el producto innovador. 6. Plan de farmacovigilancia. 7. Programa de gestión de riesgo.
rows.location: Título II, Artículo 102 (registro sanitario de productos biológicos), numerales 5-7
rows.review_note: Review: the introductory sentence of Art. 102 ("se requerirá, de forma complementaria al artículo 29 de la Ley 419 de 2024, lo siguiente") is on the same page, four items above; the full article from heading to item 7 exceeds the 1000-character quote limit, so the quote keeps items 5-7. Double-check: kept below 90 because the duty wording is outside the quote. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: 5. Own clinical studies demonstrating the safety, efficacy and quality of the product, or comparative studies with the innovator product. 6. Pharmacovigilance plan. 7. Risk management programme.

f.title: Include a pharmacovigilance plan for homeopathic medicines with approved therapeutic indications
f.statement: For authorisation of a homeopathic medicine with an approved therapeutic indication, the applicant must present proof of therapeutic benefit through toxicological studies, clinical studies, proof of therapeutic benefit for single or compound homeopathic medicines, a tolerance test and a pharmacovigilance plan.

rows.actor: Applicant for sanitary registration of a homeopathic medicine with therapeutic indication
rows.quote: Artículo 155. Para la autorización de los medicamentos homeopáticos con indicación terapéutica aprobada, se seguirá el procedimiento establecido en la Sección II del presente Capítulo, sustituyendo la frase “medicamento Homeopático con Indicaciones terapéuticas aprobadas.” Presentará prueba de beneficio terapéutico, a través de: 1. Estudios Toxicológicos. 2. Estudios Clínicos. 55 No. 30028-C Gaceta Oficial Digital, viernes 10 de mayo de 2024 56 3. Prueba de Beneficio terapéutico para medicamentos homeopáticos unitarios o compuestos. 4. Prueba de Tolerancia. 5. Plan de Farmacovigilancia.
rows.review_note: Review: quote extended from the article heading (across the page break) so the duty is quoted with the PV plan item. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Article 155. For the authorisation of homeopathic medicines with an approved therapeutic indication, the procedure established in Section II of this Chapter shall be followed, substituting the phrase "Homeopathic medicine with approved therapeutic indications." It shall present proof of therapeutic benefit through: 1. Toxicological studies. 2. Clinical studies. [page header] 3. Proof of therapeutic benefit for single or compound homeopathic medicines. 4. Tolerance test. 5. Pharmacovigilance Plan.

f.title: Comply with the national Good Pharmacovigilance Practices manual
f.statement: The components of the National Pharmacovigilance System must comply with the provisions of the Good Pharmacovigilance Practices manual.
f.clause: Título II, Capítulo XXIII, Sección I, Artículo 301

rows.actor: National and foreign medicine manufacturers and medicine distribution agencies (marketing authorisation holders)
rows.quote: Artículo 301. Los componentes del Sistema Nacional de Farmacovigilancia deben cumplir con lo establecido en el manual de Buenas Prácticas de Farmacovigilancia.
rows.location: Título II, Capítulo XXIII, Sección I, Artículo 301
rows.review_note: Review: statement trimmed to the quote; Article 314 names manufacturers and distribution agencies as components of the System. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Article 301. The components of the National Pharmacovigilance System must comply with the provisions of the Good Pharmacovigilance Practices manual.

f.title: Manufacturers and distributors send ADR and therapeutic-failure notifications directly to the CNFV on the official forms
f.statement: Notifications of suspected adverse reactions and therapeutic failures must be made on the forms established by the National Directorate of Pharmacy and Drugs; distribution companies and manufacturers send them directly to the National Pharmacovigilance Centre (CNFV), on printed forms or through the existing electronic notification mechanisms.

rows.actor: National and foreign medicine manufacturers and medicine distribution agencies (marketing authorisation holders)
rows.quote: Artículo 311. La notificación de sospechas de reacciones adversas y fallas terapéuticas de los medicamentos se hará en los formularios establecidos por la Dirección Nacional de Farmacia y Drogas, de la siguiente manera: 1. Los profesionales de la salud del sector estatal y pacientes remitirán estos formularios a los CRFV, CIFV y Centros Locales de Farmacovigilancia correspondiente, quienes a su vez los enviarán al CNFV. 2. Los profesionales de la salud, pacientes y las unidades prestadoras de servicios de salud del sector privado, los remitirán directamente al CNFV. 3. Las empresas distribuidoras y fabricantes lo enviarán directamente al CNFV. Las notificaciones se podrán realizar en los formularios disponibles, ya sea en formato impreso o mediante los mecanismos de notificación electrónica existentes.
rows.review_note: Review: added in the review pass (missed in extraction). Items 1-2 concern health professionals and patients and are quoted for context only. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Article 311. Notification of suspected adverse reactions and therapeutic failures of medicines shall be made on the forms established by the National Directorate of Pharmacy and Drugs, as follows: 1. Public-sector health professionals and patients shall send these forms to the corresponding CRFV, CIFV and Local Pharmacovigilance Centres, which in turn shall send them to the CNFV. 2. Private-sector health professionals, patients and health service units shall send them directly to the CNFV. 3. Distribution companies and manufacturers shall send them directly to the CNFV. Notifications may be made on the available forms, either in printed format or through the existing electronic notification mechanisms.

f.title: Manufacturers and distributors bear responsibility for PV obligations
f.statement: Responsibility for fulfilling the pharmacovigilance obligations of this regulation lies with national and foreign medicine manufacturers and medicine distribution agencies as components of the National Pharmacovigilance System.
f.clause: Título II, Capítulo XXIII, Sección III, Artículo 314

rows.actor: National and foreign medicine manufacturers and medicine distribution agencies (marketing authorisation holders)
rows.quote: Artículo 314. La responsabilidad derivada del cumplimiento de las obligaciones de farmacovigilancia descritas en esta norma recae en los laboratorios fabricantes de medicamentos nacionales y extranjeros y en las agencias distribuidoras de medicamentos como componentes del Sistema Nacional de Farmacovigilancia.
rows.location: Título II, Capítulo XXIII, Sección III, Artículo 314
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Article 314. Responsibility arising from compliance with the pharmacovigilance obligations described in this standard lies with national and foreign medicine manufacturing laboratories and with medicine distribution agencies as components of the National Pharmacovigilance System.

f.title: Report suspected adverse reactions to medicines
f.statement: National and foreign medicine manufacturers and medicine distribution agencies are obliged to notify suspected adverse reactions to medicines.

rows.actor: National and foreign medicine manufacturers and medicine distribution agencies (marketing authorisation holders)
rows.quote: Artículo 315. Los laboratorios fabricantes de medicamentos nacionales y extranjeros y las agencias distribuidoras de medicamentos están obligados a notificar las sospechas de reacciones adversas de los medicamentos.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Article 315. National and foreign medicine manufacturing laboratories and medicine distribution agencies are obliged to notify suspected adverse reactions to medicines.

f.title: Reporting covers products marketed in Panama and also marketed abroad by the same manufacturer
f.statement: Manufacturers and distribution agencies must notify as regulated in this Decree for products marketed in Panama that are also marketed in other countries, with the same or a different trade name (but from the same manufacturer), route of administration, pharmaceutical form and strength.

rows.actor: National and foreign medicine manufacturers and medicine distribution agencies (marketing authorisation holders)
rows.quote: los productos comercializados en nuestro país y que se comercializan también en otros países, ya sea con el mismo o con diferente nombre comercial (pero del mismo fabricante), vía de administración, forma farmacéutica y concentración.
rows.review_note: Review: wording is ambiguous on whether foreign cases must be reported; statement keeps the source wording without adding a foreign-case duty. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: [Article 316 ... shall notify what is regulated in this Executive Decree for] the products marketed in our country that are also marketed in other countries, whether with the same or a different trade name (but from the same manufacturer), route of administration, pharmaceutical form and strength.

f.title: Maintain a pharmacovigilance system
f.statement: National and foreign manufacturers and distribution agencies must maintain a pharmacovigilance system that allows them to assume their responsibilities and obligations so as to ensure timely measures on suspected adverse reactions, therapeutic failures and other safety situations arising from the use of medicines marketed in Panama.

rows.actor: National and foreign medicine manufacturers and medicine distribution agencies (marketing authorisation holders)
rows.quote: Artículo 317. Los laboratorios fabricantes de medicamentos nacionales y extranjeros, así como las agencias distribuidoras de medicamentos, mantendrán obligatoriamente, un Sistema de Farmacovigilancia que les permita asumir sus responsabilidades y obligaciones con tal de asegurar la adopción de las medidas oportunas relacionadas al manejo de las sospechas de reacciones adversas y fallas terapéuticas o demás situaciones de seguridad derivadas del uso de medicamentos que se comercializan en nuestro país.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Article 317. National and foreign medicine manufacturing laboratories, as well as medicine distribution agencies, shall mandatorily maintain a Pharmacovigilance System allowing them to assume their responsibilities and obligations so as to ensure the adoption of timely measures relating to the management of suspected adverse reactions and therapeutic failures or other safety situations arising from the use of medicines marketed in our country.

f.title: Have MedDRA and WHODrug access for ICH-compliant electronic ADR reporting
f.statement: To fulfil the legal duty to notify suspected ADRs and therapeutic failures, marketing authorisation holders, national and foreign laboratories and distribution agencies must have access to the MedDRA and WHODrug coding systems for reports that comply with the ICH international electronic reporting standard, following the operational guidelines of the National Directorate of Pharmacy and Drugs.
f.processes: Terminology governance; E2B / transmission; Safety system configuration

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holders, national and foreign pharmaceutical laboratories and distribution agencies
rows.quote: Artículo 318. Para efectos del cumplimiento del deber legal de notificación de Sospechas de Reacciones Adversas a Medicamentos y Fallas Terapéuticas los Titulares de Registros Sanitarios, Laboratorios Farmacéuticos Nacionales y Extranjeros y las Agencias Distribuidoras, deberán contar con los accesos al sistema de codificación MedDRA y WHODrug para el reporte de Sospechas de Reacciones Adversas a Medicamentos y Fallas Terapéuticas que cumplan con el estándar internacional de la Conferencia Internacional de Armonización (ICH), de reporte electrónico, atendiendo los lineamientos operativos que la Dirección Nacional de Farmacia y Drogas determine.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Article 318. For compliance with the legal duty to notify Suspected Adverse Drug Reactions and Therapeutic Failures, Holders of Sanitary Registrations, National and Foreign Pharmaceutical Laboratories and Distribution Agencies shall have access to the MedDRA and WHODrug coding systems for reporting Suspected ADRs and Therapeutic Failures that comply with the international electronic reporting standard of the International Conference on Harmonisation (ICH), following the operational guidelines determined by the National Directorate of Pharmacy and Drugs.

f.title: Designate a qualified PV responsible person and notify their contact details to the CNFV
f.statement: Manufacturers and distribution agencies must designate a suitably qualified health professional with pharmacovigilance knowledge as pharmacovigilance responsible person (RFV), who is the valid contact with the National Pharmacovigilance Centre (CNFV); the name, physical address in the country of residence, e-mail and telephone of the designated person, and any changes, must be communicated to the CNFV.

rows.actor: National and foreign medicine manufacturers and medicine distribution agencies (marketing authorisation holders)
rows.quote: Artículo 319. Los laboratorios fabricantes de medicamentos nacionales y extranjeros y las agencias distribuidoras de medicamentos deberán designar a un profesional de la salud idóneo calificado con conocimientos en farmacovigilancia como responsable de farmacovigilancia (RFV). Este RFV será el interlocutor válido ante el Centro Nacional de Farmacovigilancia en materia de farmacovigilancia. Se comunicará el nombre, dirección física en el país donde resida, correo electrónico y teléfono de la persona designada, así como los cambios del mencionado responsable, al Centro Nacional de Farmacovigilancia (CNFV).
rows.review_note: Review: quote extended to the full contiguous passage (page header text copied verbatim) or statement trimmed so that the statement is fully supported. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Article 319. National and foreign medicine manufacturing laboratories and medicine distribution agencies shall designate a suitably qualified health professional with knowledge of pharmacovigilance as pharmacovigilance responsible person (RFV). This RFV shall be the valid contact with the National Pharmacovigilance Centre on pharmacovigilance matters. The name, physical address in the country of residence, e-mail and telephone of the designated person, as well as changes of that responsible person, shall be communicated to the National Pharmacovigilance Centre (CNFV).

f.title: Local representative required when a foreign manufacturer's RFV does not reside in Panama
f.statement: If the RFV of a foreign manufacturer does not reside in Panama, the manufacturer must designate a qualified health professional with PV knowledge to represent them before the CNFV and communicate the representative's name, physical address, e-mail and telephone and any changes.

rows.actor: Foreign medicine manufacturers
rows.quote: Si el RFV de los laboratorios fabricantes de medicamentos extranjeros no reside en nuestro país, designará a un profesional de la salud idóneo calificado con conocimientos en farmacovigilancia que lo represente ante el CNFV. Se comunicará el nombre, dirección física, correo electrónico y teléfono de la persona designada, así como los cambios de representante.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: If the RFV of foreign medicine manufacturing laboratories does not reside in our country, they shall designate a suitably qualified health professional with knowledge of pharmacovigilance to represent them before the CNFV. The name, physical address, e-mail and telephone of the designated person, as well as changes of representative, shall be communicated.

f.title: Communicate the RFV designation by formal note with evidence of qualifications
f.statement: The RFV (and, where applicable, representative) designation must be communicated by formal note, which may initially be sent by e-mail, with evidence or documents showing that both the RFV and the pharmacovigilance representative are suitably qualified health professionals with pharmacovigilance knowledge.

rows.actor: National and foreign medicine manufacturers and medicine distribution agencies (marketing authorisation holders)
rows.quote: La comunicación se realizará mediante nota formal, la cual puede ser remitida inicialmente por correo electrónico. Además, deberán adjuntar las evidencias o documentos que corroboren que tanto el RFV como el Representante de Farmacovigilancia son profesionales de la salud idóneos calificados y con conocimientos en farmacovigilancia.
rows.review_note: Review: split from the RFV designation row so that each statement has its own quote. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: The communication shall be made by formal note, which may initially be sent by e-mail. In addition, they shall attach the evidence or documents corroborating that both the RFV and the Pharmacovigilance Representative are suitably qualified health professionals with knowledge of pharmacovigilance.

f.title: Notify changes to the RFV or their details within 7 business days of designation
f.statement: Manufacturers and distribution agencies must communicate changes to the RFV information or the designation of a new pharmacovigilance responsible person within seven business days from the designation.

rows.actor: National and foreign medicine manufacturers and medicine distribution agencies (marketing authorisation holders)
rows.quote: Artículo 320. Los laboratorios fabricantes nacionales y extranjeros, y agencias distribuidoras de medicamentos, comunicarán los cambios en la información descrita en el artículo anterior o la designación de un nuevo responsable de farmacovigilancia en un plazo de siete días hábiles a partir de la designación.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Article 320. National and foreign manufacturing laboratories and medicine distribution agencies shall communicate changes to the information described in the previous article or the designation of a new pharmacovigilance responsible person within seven business days from the designation.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Changes to RFV details or designation of a new RFV

f.title: RFV functions: ICSR management, PSUR review, authority requests, signal criteria and PASS oversight
f.statement: The pharmacovigilance responsible person must ensure all activities needed for good pharmacovigilance of the medicines marketed are carried out, including: management, notification, collection and evaluation of suspected ADRs and therapeutic failures to the CNFV; review and delivery of periodic safety reports; rapid and complete responses to CNFV information requests on safety or effectiveness; criteria for identifying and grading the seriousness of alert signals; and supervision of post-marketing safety studies.
f.processes: Safety governance; Case processing & follow-up; Signal detection

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance responsible person (RFV)
rows.quote: Artículo 321. El responsable de farmacovigilancia debe asegurar que se lleven a cabo todas las actividades necesarias para cumplir con las funciones que permitan un buen desarrollo de la farmacovigilancia de los medicamentos que comercialicen los laboratorios fabricantes de medicamentos nacionales y extranjeros, así como las agencias distribuidoras de medicamentos. Entre las funciones tenemos las siguientes: 1. Gestión, notificación, recopilación y evaluación de las sospechas de reacciones adversas y fallas terapéuticas al Centro Nacional de Farmacovigilancia. 2. Revisión y entrega de los informes periódicos de seguridad. 3. Responder rápida y completamente cualquier petición de información del Centro Nacional de Farmacovigilancia en materia de seguridad o efectividad de los medicamentos. 4. Establecimientos de criterios de identificación y de valoración de la gravedad de las señales de alerta. 5. Supervisión de los estudios de seguridad post-comercialización.
rows.review_note: Review: items 6-7 moved to the next row, which quotes them. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Article 321. The pharmacovigilance responsible person must ensure that all activities necessary to fulfil the functions enabling good pharmacovigilance of the medicines marketed by national and foreign manufacturing laboratories and distribution agencies are carried out. The functions include: 1. Management, notification, collection and evaluation of suspected adverse reactions and therapeutic failures to the National Pharmacovigilance Centre. 2. Review and delivery of periodic safety reports. 3. Responding rapidly and completely to any request for information from the National Pharmacovigilance Centre on the safety or effectiveness of medicines. 4. Establishing criteria for identifying and assessing the seriousness of alert signals. 5. Supervision of post-marketing safety studies.

f.title: RFV: periodically review the literature on the products' active substances and excipients, and cooperate with the CNFV
f.statement: The RFV functions also include periodic review of the scientific literature on suspected adverse reactions to the active substances or excipients of the products manufactured or distributed, and cooperation with the CNFV on topics, programmes or projects on medicine safety and efficacy when formally required.

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance responsible person (RFV)
rows.quote: 6. Revisión periódica de la literatura científica sobre sospecha de reacciones adversas a los principios activos o excipientes de los productos fabricados por el laboratorio fabricante o distribuidos por la agencia distribuidora de medicamentos. 7. Cooperar con el Centro Nacional de Farmacovigilancia en temas, programas y/o proyectos relacionados a la seguridad y eficacia de los medicamentos, cuando así sea requerido formalmente.
rows.review_note: Review: quote extended to the full contiguous passage (page header text copied verbatim) or statement trimmed so that the statement is fully supported. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: 6. Periodic review of the scientific literature on suspected adverse reactions to the active substances or excipients of the products manufactured by the manufacturing laboratory or distributed by the medicine distribution agency. 7. Cooperate with the National Pharmacovigilance Centre on topics, programmes and/or projects related to the safety and efficacy of medicines, when formally required.

f.title: Report serious and non-serious domestic suspected ADRs with patient data and reaction description
f.statement: Manufacturers and distribution agencies must submit notifications of serious and non-serious, expected and unexpected suspected ADRs occurring in Panama with the information needed for evaluation, including patient data (name or initials, gender, age, weight, height, clinical history) and a description of the reaction (seriousness, start and end dates of signs and symptoms, evolution and outcome).

rows.actor: National and foreign medicine manufacturers and medicine distribution agencies (marketing authorisation holders)
rows.quote: Artículo 322. Los laboratorios fabricantes tanto nacionales como extranjeros y las agencias distribuidoras, deben presentar las notificaciones de sospechas de reacciones adversas serias y no serias, esperadas y no esperadas ocurridas en Panamá, con la información necesaria para una adecuada evaluación que se describe a continuación: 1. Datos del Paciente: nombre o iniciales del paciente, género, edad, peso, estatura, historia clínica. 2. Descripción de la sospecha de reacción adversa: incluyendo la gravedad, fechas de inicio y término de los signos y síntomas, su evolución y desenlace.
rows.review_note: Review: quote extended to the full contiguous passage (page header text copied verbatim) or statement trimmed so that the statement is fully supported. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Article 322. National and foreign manufacturing laboratories and distribution agencies must submit notifications of serious and non-serious, expected and unexpected suspected adverse reactions occurring in Panama, with the information necessary for an adequate evaluation described below: 1. Patient data: name or initials, gender, age, weight, height, clinical history. 2. Description of the suspected adverse reaction: including seriousness, start and end dates of signs and symptoms, their evolution and outcome.

f.title: Domestic ADR reports: suspect and concomitant medicine details and reporter data
f.statement: Domestic suspected ADR notifications must give the suspect medicine (trade name, active ingredients, indication, dose, route, form, manufacturer, batch, expiry, exact administration and withdrawal dates, action taken and rechallenge data) and the same information for concomitant medicines or vitamin, dietary or herbal supplements, plus reporter or PV contact data (name, signature and licence registration, telephone, e-mail and health facility).

rows.actor: National and foreign medicine manufacturers and medicine distribution agencies (marketing authorisation holders)
rows.quote: 3. Medicamento sospechoso: nombre del medicamento (comercial), ingrediente(s) activo(s), indicación, dosis, vía de administración, forma farmacéutica, nombre del fabricante, número de lote y fecha de vencimiento y fecha exacta de la administración y suspensión del medicamento, acción tomada con el fármaco y datos de reexposición si se ha producido. Además, incluir la información correspondiente para los medicamentos concomitantes o suplementos vitamínicos, dietéticos o derivado de plantas medicinales. 4. Datos del notificador o contacto de farmacovigilancia: nombre, firma y registro de idoneidad, teléfono de contacto, dirección de correo electrónico e instalación de salud de donde procede la notificación.
rows.review_note: Review: quote extended to the full contiguous passage (page header text copied verbatim) or statement trimmed so that the statement is fully supported. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: 3. Suspect medicine: name of the medicine (trade name), active ingredient(s), indication, dose, route of administration, pharmaceutical form, manufacturer name, batch number and expiry date and exact date of administration and withdrawal of the medicine, action taken with the drug and rechallenge data if it occurred. In addition, include the corresponding information for concomitant medicines or vitamin, dietary or herbal supplements. 4. Reporter or pharmacovigilance contact data: name, signature and licence registration, contact telephone, e-mail address and health facility where the notification comes from.

f.title: Report domestic suspected ADRs with causality, expectedness, case reference and at least the minimum data
f.statement: Manufacturers and distribution agencies must determine causality and whether the reaction is expected or unexpected, and include a case reference or number and the evaluation summary. The minimum content is patient name, adverse reaction(s) with onset date, suspect medicine(s) with treatment start date, and reporter data, though the notification should be as complete as possible; it must contain a suspected adverse reaction, not an adverse event.

rows.actor: National and foreign medicine manufacturers and medicine distribution agencies (marketing authorisation holders)
rows.quote: Adicional deben determinar la causalidad, si la reacción adversa es esperada o no esperada, incluir referencia o número de caso y el resumen de la evaluación. La información mínima que la notificación debe contener es: nombre del paciente, reacción(es) adversa(s) con su fecha de inicio, medicamento(s) sospechoso(s) con su fecha de inicio de tratamiento y con los datos del notificador, sin embargo, se velará por que la notificación sea lo más completa con los requisitos antes establecidos. La notificación debe contener una sospecha de reacción adversa como tal, y no un evento adverso.
rows.review_note: Review: quote extended to the full contiguous passage (page header text copied verbatim) or statement trimmed so that the statement is fully supported. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Additionally, they must determine causality and whether the adverse reaction is expected or unexpected, include a reference or case number and the evaluation summary. The minimum information the notification must contain is: patient name, adverse reaction(s) with onset date, suspect medicine(s) with treatment start date and the reporter details; however, the notification shall be as complete as possible with the requirements set out above. The notification must contain a suspected adverse reaction as such, and not an adverse event.

f.title: Report domestic suspected therapeutic failures with patient data and failure description
f.statement: Manufacturers and distribution agencies must submit notifications of suspected therapeutic failures occurring in Panama with the information needed for evaluation, including patient data (name or initials, gender, age, weight, height, clinical history) and a description of the suspected failure (onset date, evolution and outcome).
f.applicability: Suspected therapeutic failures occurring in Panama

rows.actor: National and foreign medicine manufacturers and medicine distribution agencies (marketing authorisation holders)
rows.quote: Artículo 323. Los laboratorios fabricantes tanto nacionales como extranjeros y las agencias distribuidoras de medicamentos, deben presentar las notificaciones de sospechas de fallas terapéuticas ocurridas en Panamá, con la información necesaria para una adecuada evaluación que se describe a continuación: 1. Datos del Paciente: nombre o iniciales del paciente, género, edad, peso, estatura, historia clínica. 2. Descripción de la sospecha de falla terapéutica: incluyendo fecha de aparición de la sospecha, su evolución y desenlace.
rows.review_note: Review: quote extended to the full contiguous passage (page header text copied verbatim) or statement trimmed so that the statement is fully supported. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Article 323. National and foreign manufacturing laboratories and medicine distribution agencies must submit notifications of suspected therapeutic failures occurring in Panama, with the information necessary for an adequate evaluation described below: 1. Patient data: name or initials, gender, age, weight, height, clinical history. 2. Description of the suspected therapeutic failure: including date of onset of the suspicion, its evolution and outcome.

f.title: Domestic therapeutic-failure reports: suspect and concomitant medicine details and reporter data
f.statement: Therapeutic-failure notifications must give the suspect medicine (trade name, active ingredients, indication, dose, route, form, commercial presentation, registration number, manufacturer, batch, expiry, exact administration and withdrawal dates and action taken) and the same information for concomitant medicines or supplements, plus reporter or PV contact data (name, signature and licence registration, telephone, e-mail and health facility).
f.applicability: Suspected therapeutic failures occurring in Panama

rows.actor: National and foreign medicine manufacturers and medicine distribution agencies (marketing authorisation holders)
rows.quote: 3. Medicamento sospechoso: nombre del medicamento (comercial), ingrediente(s) activo(s), indicación, dosis, vía de administración, forma farmacéutica, presentación comercial, número de registro sanitario, nombre del fabricante, número de lote y fecha de vencimiento y fecha exacta de la administración y suspensión del medicamento y acción tomada con el fármaco. Además, incluir la información correspondiente para los medicamentos concomitantes o suplementos vitamínicos, dietéticos o derivado de plantas medicinales. 4. Datos del notificador o contacto de farmacovigilancia: nombre, firma y registro de idoneidad, teléfono de contacto, dirección de correo electrónico e instalación de salud de donde procede la notificación.
rows.review_note: Review: quote extended to the full contiguous passage (page header text copied verbatim) or statement trimmed so that the statement is fully supported. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: 3. Suspect medicine: name of the medicine (trade name), active ingredient(s), indication, dose, route of administration, pharmaceutical form, commercial presentation, sanitary registration number, manufacturer name, batch number and expiry date and exact date of administration and withdrawal of the medicine and action taken with the drug. In addition, include the corresponding information for concomitant medicines or vitamin, dietary or herbal supplements. 4. Reporter or pharmacovigilance contact data: name, signature and licence registration, contact telephone, e-mail address and health facility where the notification comes from.

f.title: Report domestic therapeutic failures with causality, justification, case reference and the minimum data
f.statement: For suspected therapeutic failures, manufacturers and distribution agencies must determine causality, justify the characterisation as therapeutic failure, and include a case reference and evaluation summary. Minimum content: patient name or identifier, the suspected failure, suspect medicine(s) with treatment start date and reporter data, though the notification should be as complete as possible.
f.applicability: Suspected therapeutic failures occurring in Panama

rows.actor: National and foreign medicine manufacturers and medicine distribution agencies (marketing authorisation holders)
rows.quote: Adicional deben determinar la causalidad, justificación para caracterizarlo como una falla terapéutica, incluir referencia o número de caso y el resumen de la evaluación. 89 No. 30028-C Gaceta Oficial Digital, viernes 10 de mayo de 2024 90 La información mínima que la notificación debe contener es: nombre del paciente (o algún identificador del paciente), sospecha de falla terapéutica, medicamento(s) sospechoso(s) con su fecha de inicio de tratamiento y con los datos del notificador, sin embargo, se velará por que la notificación sea lo más completa con los requisitos antes establecidos.
rows.review_note: Review: quote extended to the full contiguous passage (page header text copied verbatim) or statement trimmed so that the statement is fully supported. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Additionally, they must determine causality, the justification for characterising it as a therapeutic failure, and include a reference or case number and the evaluation summary. [page header] The minimum information the notification must contain is: patient name (or some patient identifier), suspected therapeutic failure, suspect medicine(s) with treatment start date and the reporter details; however, the notification shall be as complete as possible with the requirements set out above.

f.title: Use case follow-up to complete information; record when the reporter declines further contact
f.statement: Manufacturers and distribution agencies must use case follow-up to complete the requested information. If during the investigation the reporter states that no further information is available or that they do not wish to be contacted again, this must be indicated on the notification form.

rows.actor: National and foreign medicine manufacturers and medicine distribution agencies (marketing authorisation holders)
rows.quote: Artículo 324. Los laboratorios fabricantes y las agencias distribuidoras utilizarán la figura de seguimiento de casos para completar la información solicitada en los artículos 295 y 296 del presente Decreto Ejecutivo. Si durante la investigación de un caso, el notificador le indica al laboratorio fabricante o agencia distribuidora, que no cuenta con más información o que no desea ser contactado nuevamente, dicha situación deberá ser indicada en el formulario de notificación correspondiente.
rows.review_note: Review: quote extended to the whole article. The article cites articles 295 and 296, which appear to be a wrong cross-reference (the case data requirements are in articles 322 and 323). Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Article 324. Manufacturing laboratories and distribution agencies shall use case follow-up to complete the information requested in articles 295 and 296 of this Executive Decree. If, during the investigation of a case, the reporter tells the manufacturing laboratory or distribution agency that they have no more information or do not wish to be contacted again, this situation shall be indicated on the corresponding notification form.

f.title: Report non-serious domestic suspected ADRs within 15 business days of awareness
f.statement: Non-serious suspected adverse reactions, expected or unexpected, occurring in Panama must be notified to the National Pharmacovigilance Centre on the national notification form or the CIOMS-I form within 15 business days from when the manufacturer or distribution agency becomes aware of them.
f.systems: CIOMS I form; National notification form

rows.actor: National and foreign medicine manufacturers and medicine distribution agencies (marketing authorisation holders)
rows.quote: Artículo 325. Se notificarán al Centro Nacional de Farmacovigilancia, mediante el formulario de notificación nacional o en el formulario CIOMS-I, las sospechas de reacción adversa no serias esperadas o no esperadas, que hayan ocurrido en el país, en un plazo de hasta quince días hábiles, contados desde que el laboratorio fabricante de medicamentos nacional y extranjero o la agencia distribuidora de medicamentos tenga conocimiento de la misma.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Article 325. Non-serious suspected adverse reactions, expected or unexpected, that occurred in the country shall be notified to the National Pharmacovigilance Centre on the national notification form or the CIOMS-I form within up to fifteen business days, counted from when the national or foreign medicine manufacturer or the medicine distribution agency becomes aware of it.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Non-serious suspected ADRs (expected or unexpected) occurring in Panama

f.title: Report suspected therapeutic failures with a case evaluation including root-cause analysis
f.statement: Suspected therapeutic failures must also be sent on the national notification form for that purpose, together with a case evaluation report including an analysis of the possible root cause of the problem and the actions taken.

rows.actor: National and foreign medicine manufacturers and medicine distribution agencies (marketing authorisation holders)
rows.quote: También se enviarán las sospechas de fallas terapéuticas en el formulario de notificación nacional destinados para tal fin. Además, se debe enviar un informe de evaluación del caso que incluya un análisis de la posible causa raíz del problema reportado y las acciones tomadas.
rows.review_note: Review: no separate deadline is stated for therapeutic failures; placed in the 15-business-day article, so no deadline_rule. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Suspected therapeutic failures shall also be sent on the national notification form intended for that purpose. In addition, a case evaluation report must be sent including an analysis of the possible root cause of the reported problem and the actions taken.

f.title: Send original forms in a sealed envelope unless electronic reporting is available; reports in Spanish
f.statement: Non-serious ADR and therapeutic failure forms are sent in original directly to the CNFV of the National Directorate of Pharmacy and Drugs in a sealed envelope, unless electronic notification mechanisms are available, in which case industry must use them. ADR and therapeutic failure notifications must be in Spanish.

rows.actor: National and foreign medicine manufacturers and medicine distribution agencies (marketing authorisation holders)
rows.quote: Estos formularios se enviarán en original directamente al Centro Nacional de Farmacovigilancia de la Dirección Nacional de Farmacia y Drogas, en un sobre cerrado, salvo que ya se encuentren disponibles los mecanismos de notificación electrónica, los cuales serán los que tendrá que utilizar la industria farmacéutica. Las notificaciones de sospechas de reacciones adversas y fallas terapéuticas de los medicamentos deberán ser remitidas en español.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: These forms shall be sent in original directly to the National Pharmacovigilance Centre of the National Directorate of Pharmacy and Drugs in a sealed envelope, unless electronic notification mechanisms are already available, which the pharmaceutical industry shall then have to use. Notifications of suspected adverse reactions and therapeutic failures of medicines shall be submitted in Spanish.

f.title: Report serious domestic suspected ADRs within 10 business days of awareness
f.statement: Serious suspected adverse reactions, expected or unexpected, occurring in Panama must be notified to the CNFV on the national notification form or the CIOMS-I form within 10 business days from when the manufacturer or distribution agency becomes aware of them.
f.systems: CIOMS I form; National notification form

rows.actor: National and foreign medicine manufacturers and medicine distribution agencies (marketing authorisation holders)
rows.quote: Artículo 326. Se notificarán al Centro Nacional de Farmacovigilancia, mediante el formulario de notificación nacional o en el formulario CIOMS-I, las sospechas de reacción adversa serias esperadas o no esperadas, que hayan ocurrido en el país, en un plazo de hasta diez días hábiles, contados desde que el laboratorio fabricante de medicamentos nacional y extranjero o la agencia distribuidora de medicamentos tenga conocimiento de esta.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Article 326. Serious suspected adverse reactions, expected or unexpected, that occurred in the country shall be notified to the National Pharmacovigilance Centre on the national notification form or the CIOMS-I form within up to ten business days, counted from when the national or foreign medicine manufacturer or the medicine distribution agency becomes aware of it.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Serious suspected ADRs (expected or unexpected) occurring in Panama

f.title: Send serious ADR forms in Spanish by e-mail first, then in original, unless electronic reporting is available
f.statement: Serious suspected ADR forms must be sent in Spanish, first by e-mail and then in original in a sealed envelope directly to the CNFV of the National Directorate of Pharmacy and Drugs, unless electronic notification mechanisms are available, in which case industry must use them.
f.systems: CIOMS I form; National notification form

rows.actor: National and foreign medicine manufacturers and medicine distribution agencies (marketing authorisation holders)
rows.quote: Estos formularios se enviarán en el idioma español inicialmente por correo electrónico y luego en original en un sobre cerrado directamente al Centro Nacional de Farmacovigilancia de la Dirección Nacional de Farmacia y Drogas, salvo que ya se encuentren disponibles los mecanismos de notificación electrónica, los cuales serán los que tendrá que utilizar la industria farmacéutica.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: These forms shall be sent in Spanish, initially by e-mail and then in original in a sealed envelope directly to the National Pharmacovigilance Centre of the National Directorate of Pharmacy and Drugs, unless electronic notification mechanisms are already available, which the pharmaceutical industry shall then have to use.

f.title: Submit periodic safety reports for innovator, biological, biotechnological and interchangeable products
f.statement: Periodic safety reports must be submitted to the CNFV for innovator, biotechnological and biological medicines and products whose active substances are on the lists of interchangeable medicines with a current sanitary registration in Panama; alternatively, a PBRER may be submitted.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holders of innovator, biological, biotechnological and interchangeable-list medicines
rows.quote: Artículo 327. Los informes periódicos de seguridad serán presentados al Centro Nacional de Farmacovigilancia para los medicamentos innovadores, biotecnológicos, biológicos y productos cuyos principios activos se encuentren en las listas de medicamentos intercambiables con registro sanitario vigente en Panamá. En su defecto podrá presentar el Informe Periódico de Evaluación del Beneficio/Riesgo (PBRER).
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Article 327. Periodic safety reports shall be submitted to the National Pharmacovigilance Centre for innovator, biotechnological and biological medicines and products whose active substances are on the lists of interchangeable medicines with a current sanitary registration in Panama. Alternatively, the Periodic Benefit-Risk Evaluation Report (PBRER) may be submitted.

f.title: PSUR/PBRER frequency: 6-monthly for 2 years, annually for 3 years, then 5-yearly; send annual schedule
f.statement: PSURs or PBRERs must be submitted every six months during the first two years of marketing, annually for the following three years, every fifth year after the first five years, and at any time on CNFV request (including for medicines not listed in Article 327). Periods count from the date of sanitary registration in Panama or the international birth date of the molecule. Manufacturers must send the CNFV an annual schedule of PSUR/PBRER deliveries.

rows.actor: National and foreign medicine manufacturers and medicine distribution agencies (marketing authorisation holders)
rows.deadline: 6-monthly (years 1-2), annually (years 3-5), every 5 years thereafter, and on request
rows.quote: Artículo 328. La frecuencia de presentación de los informes periódicos de seguridad o Informes Periódicos de Evaluación del Beneficio/Riesgo, más reciente será la siguiente: 1. Cada seis meses, los dos primeros años de comercialización. 2. Anualmente, los tres años subsiguientes a partir de la comercialización. 3. Cada quinto año, luego de los primeros cinco años de comercialización. 90 No. 30028-C Gaceta Oficial Digital, viernes 10 de mayo de 2024 91 4. En cualquier momento a solicitud del Centro Nacional de Farmacovigilancia, incluyendo para los medicamentos que no se describen en el artículo anterior. Estos tiempos serán contados a partir de la fecha de autorización de registro sanitario en el país o la fecha de nacimiento internacional de la molécula. Los laboratorios fabricantes deberá enviar al CNFV el cronograma anual de entrega de los IPS o PBRER.
rows.review_note: Review: quote extended to the full contiguous passage (page header text copied verbatim) or statement trimmed so that the statement is fully supported. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Article 328. The frequency of submission of the most recent periodic safety reports or Periodic Benefit/Risk Evaluation Reports shall be as follows: 1. Every six months during the first two years of marketing. 2. Annually for the following three years from marketing. 3. Every fifth year after the first five years of marketing. [page header] 4. At any time at the request of the National Pharmacovigilance Centre, including for medicines not described in the previous article. These periods shall be counted from the date of authorisation of the sanitary registration in the country or the international birth date of the molecule. Manufacturing laboratories shall send the CNFV the annual schedule of delivery of PSURs or PBRERs.

f.title: Submit PSURs/PBRERs within three calendar months of the data lock point
f.statement: Periodic safety reports or PBRERs must be delivered within three calendar months after the data lock point, sent to the National Directorate of Pharmacy and Drugs on compact disc or another data transfer format established and accepted by the authority.

rows.actor: National and foreign medicine manufacturers and medicine distribution agencies (marketing authorisation holders)
rows.deadline: Within 3 calendar months after the data lock point
rows.quote: Artículo 329. Los informes periódicos de seguridad o PBRER se entregarán en un plazo de tres meses calendario posterior a la fecha de cierre de datos. Estos informes periódicos de seguridad o PBRER se enviarán a la Dirección Nacional de Farmacia y Drogas en discos compactos (CD) u otro formato de transferencia de datos establecido y aceptado por la autoridad.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Article 329. Periodic safety reports or PBRERs shall be delivered within three calendar months after the data lock point. These periodic safety reports or PBRERs shall be sent to the National Directorate of Pharmacy and Drugs on compact discs (CD) or another data transfer format established and accepted by the authority.

f.title: Request changes to PSUR periods or dates in writing with detailed justification
f.statement: Any request to submit a PSUR or PBRER for periods or dates other than those established must be made in writing to the CNFV, as it is considered a "major modification", and must always be accompanied by a detailed justification.

rows.actor: National and foreign medicine manufacturers and medicine distribution agencies (marketing authorisation holders)
rows.quote: Artículo 330. Cualquier solicitud de presentación de un informe periódico de seguridad o PBRER en periodos o fechas distintas a las establecidas, deberán realizarse por escrito dirigido al Centro Nacional de Farmacovigilancia ya que se considera como “modificación de importancia mayor”. Estas solicitudes deberán acompañarse siempre de una justificación pormenorizada de los motivos que fundamenten la petición.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Article 330. Any request to submit a periodic safety report or PBRER for periods or dates other than those established shall be made in writing to the National Pharmacovigilance Centre, since it is considered a "major modification". These requests shall always be accompanied by a detailed justification of the reasons supporting the request.

f.title: Structure PSURs/PBRERs per ICH E2C(R2): sections 1-10
f.statement: PSURs or PBRERs must follow the ICH E2C(R2)-based structure, beginning with: cover page; executive summary; table of contents; introduction; worldwide marketing authorisation status; actions taken by authorities or the holder for safety reasons during the period; changes to product safety information; estimated exposure and use patterns; case presentation; and significant safety findings from clinical trials, non-interventional studies and other sources.

rows.actor: National and foreign medicine manufacturers and medicine distribution agencies (marketing authorisation holders)
rows.quote: Artículo 331. Los informes periódicos de seguridad o PBRER contarán con la siguiente estructura basada en el formato E2C (R2) de la ICH: 1. Portada. 2. Resumen Ejecutivo. 3. Tabla de contenido. 4. Introducción. 5. Situación Mundial de autorización de la comercialización del producto. 6. Actualización de las medidas adoptadas por las autoridades regulatorias o el TRS por razones de seguridad durante el periodo cubierto por el IPS. 7. Cambios a la información de la seguridad del producto. 8. Exposición estimada y patrones de uso. 9. Presentación de casos. 10. Resumen de hallazgos significantes de seguridad de estudios clínicos, de estudios de no intervención e información de otros estudios clínicos u otras fuentes.
rows.review_note: Review: split from the former structure-and-language row so each statement has its own quote. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Article 331. Periodic safety reports or PBRERs shall have the following structure based on the ICH E2C (R2) format: 1. Cover page. 2. Executive summary. 3. Table of contents. 4. Introduction. 5. Worldwide marketing authorisation status of the product. 6. Update on actions taken by regulatory authorities or the holder for safety reasons during the period covered by the PSUR. 7. Changes to the product safety information. 8. Estimated exposure and use patterns. 9. Case presentation. 10. Summary of significant safety findings from clinical trials, non-interventional studies and information from other clinical trials or other sources.

f.title: Structure PSURs/PBRERs per ICH E2C(R2): sections 11-20
f.statement: The PSUR/PBRER structure continues with: other related information; non-clinical data; other periodic reports; lack of efficacy in controlled clinical trials; signal review (new, ongoing or closed); signal and risk evaluation; benefit evaluation; integrated benefit/risk analysis for the approved indications; conclusions and actions; and annexes and appendices.

rows.actor: National and foreign medicine manufacturers and medicine distribution agencies (marketing authorisation holders)
rows.quote: 11. Otra información relacionada. 12. Datos no clínicos. 13. Otros informes periódicos. 14. Falta de eficacia en ensayos clínicos controlados. 15. Revisión de Señales: nuevas, en curso o cerradas. 16. Evaluación de señales y riesgos. 17. Evaluación del beneficio. 18. Análisis integrado del beneficio/riesgo para las indicaciones aprobadas. 19. Conclusiones y acciones. 20. Anexos y apéndices.
rows.review_note: Review: split from the former structure-and-language row so each statement has its own quote. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: 11. Other related information. 12. Non-clinical data. 13. Other periodic reports. 14. Lack of efficacy in controlled clinical trials. 15. Signal review: new, ongoing or closed. 16. Signal and risk evaluation. 17. Benefit evaluation. 18. Integrated benefit/risk analysis for the approved indications. 19. Conclusions and actions. 20. Annexes and appendices.

f.title: PSURs/PBRERs may be submitted in English with a certified Spanish translation of the executive summary
f.statement: PSURs or PBRERs may be submitted in English, with the executive summary translated into Spanish by an authorised public translator.

rows.actor: National and foreign medicine manufacturers and medicine distribution agencies (marketing authorisation holders)
rows.quote: Los IPS o PBRER se pueden presentar en idioma inglés, con la traducción al español por intérprete público autorizado del Resumen Ejecutivo.
rows.review_note: Review: the structure list is now in its own rows; this row keeps the language permission, so the level changes from Mandatory to Permitted ("se pueden presentar"). Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: PSURs or PBRERs may be submitted in English, with the translation into Spanish of the Executive Summary by an authorised public translator.

f.title: Submit the risk management plan when updated or when requested by the CNFV
f.statement: National and foreign manufacturers or marketing authorisation holders must send the risk management plan of a medicine when there are updates or when requested by the National Pharmacovigilance Centre, independently of the registration rules for biological or biotechnological products.

rows.actor: National and foreign manufacturers or sanitary registration holders
rows.quote: Artículo 332. Los laboratorios fabricantes nacionales y extranjeros o titulares del registro sanitario deberán enviar el Plan de Gestión de Riesgo de un medicamento cuando haya actualizaciones o cuando sea requerido por el Centro Nacional de Farmacovigilancia. Esto con independencia de lo regulado para el registro sanitario de producto biológico o biotecnológico.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Article 332. National and foreign manufacturing laboratories or sanitary registration holders shall send the Risk Management Plan of a medicine when there are updates or when requested by the National Pharmacovigilance Centre. This is independent of the rules for the sanitary registration of biological or biotechnological products.

f.title: Keep safety information in monographs and package inserts up to date
f.statement: After monitoring, collecting and investigating information on adverse reactions, national and foreign manufacturers are responsible for keeping the safety information in the monographs and inserts of registered medicines up to date.

rows.actor: National and foreign manufacturers
rows.quote: Artículo 334. Es responsabilidad de los fabricantes nacionales y extranjeros después de vigilar, recopilar e investigar la información acerca de las reacciones adversas; mantener actualizada la información de seguridad en las monografías e insertos de los medicamentos registrados.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Article 334. It is the responsibility of national and foreign manufacturers, after monitoring, collecting and investigating information on adverse reactions, to keep the safety information in the monographs and inserts of registered medicines up to date.

f.title: Provide safety and efficacy information requested by the CNFV
f.statement: Distribution agencies and national and foreign manufacturers must send the safety and efficacy information requested by the National Pharmacovigilance Centre.

rows.actor: National and foreign medicine manufacturers and medicine distribution agencies (marketing authorisation holders)
rows.quote: Artículo 335. Las agencias distribuidoras y los fabricantes nacionales y extranjeros deberán enviar la información que sobre seguridad y eficacia le solicite el Centro Nacional de Farmacovigilancia.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Article 335. Distribution agencies and national and foreign manufacturers shall send the information on safety and efficacy requested by the National Pharmacovigilance Centre.

f.title: Breaches of the industry PV section are serious offences under Law 419 of 2024
f.statement: Infringements of this section (participation of manufacturers and distribution agencies in the National Pharmacovigilance System) are classified as a serious offence under Law 419 of 2024 and attract the sanctions established in it.

rows.actor: National and foreign medicine manufacturers and medicine distribution agencies (marketing authorisation holders)
rows.quote: Artículo 336. Las faltas a la presente sección se tipificarán como una falta grave de acuerdo con lo contenido en la Ley 419 de 2024, por lo que corresponderán las sanciones en ella establecidas.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Article 336. Infringements of this section shall be classified as a serious offence in accordance with Law 419 of 2024, and the sanctions established therein shall apply.

dates.title: Panama Executive Decree 27 of 2024 (regulation of Law 419): enters into force
dates.scope: All provisions including the pharmacovigilance chapter (Title VIII on public procurement applies from 1 August 2024)
dates.quote: Artículo 834. Este Decreto Ejecutivo comenzará a regir de su promulgación, con excepción del Título VIII sobre la adquisición pública de medicamentos, otros productos para la salud humana, insumos de salud, dispositivos y equipos médicos que entrará a regir a partir del 1 de agosto de 2024.
dates.quote_en: Article 834. This Executive Decree shall enter into force upon its promulgation, except for Title VIII on public procurement of medicines, other products for human health, health supplies, devices and medical equipment, which shall enter into force from 1 August 2024.
dates.timing_note: Decree dated (promulgated) 2024-05-10 + 0 days = 2024-05-10. In force on promulgation; the Decree is dated 10 May 2024 and was published in Gaceta Oficial Digital No. 30028-C of Friday 10 May 2024.
